comment: This project's half of the ./client census (#160). tools/exports-walls.json is the harness's half: owned, hash-pinned, and the place the harness's own packages are sanctioned. This file is where a project sanctions its OWN verticals, so a new vertical never needs a fork of the owned file. The boundaries gate and the mobile import wall read the union of the two, through tools/lib/workspace-tiers.mjs, so no consumer can see a different list. An entry is {"package": "@app/<name>", "reason": "..."}: the package must be one under packages/verticals/, the reason must say what its ./client barrel carries into the native bundle and what stays behind `.`, and a package the owned census already lists is refused, naming both files. Additions are a security review, as in the owned file, so this one is write-guarded too: an agent stages the whole proposed file as harness-proposals/<id>.json, and a human applies it with `apply-proposal <id>`. Seeded empty, and an absent file reads as empty, so a fresh scaffold sanctions nothing here.
